name: Colmenar del Arroyo (Spain)
description: Green field with a broad blue band edged white from the upper hoist to the lower fly, charged at the centre with the crowned municipal arms of Colmenar del Arroyo (a beehive, a bridge and a tree).
history: The flag of Colmenar del Arroyo was made official in 2015, published in the Boletín Oficial de la Comunidad de Madrid on 21 August 2015; it is a cloth of proportions 2:3, green, tierced per bend in blue edged white and charged at the centre with the municipal arms.
